title: Twenty real-mechanical pairs with diagnostic previews
hypothesis: With the viterbi tracker and the energy-DP aligner, a diverse 20-utterance sample drawn from dev/test can be paired end to end without manual boundaries; most pairs will be usable previews, but boundary confidence only measures energy-valley depth, so only a minority should qualify as training-ready until phoneme boundaries are checked by hand.
